grammar_focus: 时间从句用一般现在时表将来(the moment he sees it / until he comes / before you leave)、must be 的两种用法(必须 vs 一定是)、冠词 a·an·the、notice 与 remark 的区别、be about to do … when(正要做…这时)(原创承载 NCE3 L34 考点·微净化+美式化:carved dagger→carved figurine 去兵器;£50→$50、neighborhood·古董店淘到微型名画的幸运发现,温情鉴宝故事原样保留)
scene: 古董店对许多人有一种奇特的魅力。那种更贵气的古董店,珍品被漂亮地陈列在玻璃柜里以防落尘,通常让人望而生畏。可要走进一家不那么矫饰的古董店,谁都用不着鼓足勇气。总有这样的盼头:在它那迷宫般又暗又霉、杂乱无章的房间里,在满地各式各样的破烂堆中,兴许能找到一件真正的珍品。没有人是靠碰运气发现珍品的。一个真正痴迷的淘宝人必须有耐心,尤其要有本事——一眼就看出东西的价值。要做到这点,他至少得和商人一样内行。就像一心想有所发现的科学家,他必须怀着这样的希望:总有一天会得到丰厚的回报。我的老朋友弗兰克·哈利迪就是这样一个人。他常向我讲起,他如何只花五十美元就淘到一件杰作。一个星期六早晨,弗兰克来到我家附近的一家古董店。因为以前从没来过,他发现了许多让他感兴趣的东西。一上午很快过去了,弗兰克正要离开,忽然注意到地上放着一只大包装箱。商人告诉他,那箱子刚到货,可他懒得去开。弗兰克央求他打开,商人才不情愿地把箱子撬开。里面的东西令人失望。除了一个看上去挺有意思的雕花小摆件,箱子里装满了瓷器,大多已经碎了。弗兰克轻轻把瓷器一件件取出,忽然发现箱底有一幅微型画。这幅画的构图和线条让他想起一幅他很熟悉的意大利画,于是他决定把它买下。商人只草草瞟了一眼,便说这画值五十美元。弗兰克几乎掩饰不住自己的激动,因为他知道,自己有了一个真正的发现。这幅小画后来被证实是一位古意大利大师的一件无名杰作,价值几十万美元。

grammar_card.title: 时间从句表将来 / must be 两义 / 冠词 a·an·the / notice vs remark / be about to … when
grammar_card.intro: ①时间从句(when / the moment / until / before 引导)里,用一般现在时表示将来:act the moment he sees it。②must be 有两义:表“必须(必要)”——he must be knowledgeable;表“一定是(推测)”——You must be tired。③冠词:元音音开头前用 an,辅音前用 a;初次提到用 a/an,特指已提过的用 the。④notice 是“注意到、看到(事物)”,remark 是“评论、说(一句话)”。⑤be about to do … when …:“正要做某事,这时(突然)…”。

rows: 时间从句用一般现在表将来

specialRules.rule: must be 两义要看语境:讲“必要、义务”是“必须”;根据证据下结论是“一定是”(You must be tired)。
冠词 a 用在辅音音前,an 用在元音音前(an antique / an hour);特指前面提过的那一个用 the。
美式:neighborhood(英式 neighbourhood)、dollar(英式 pound)、store(英式 shop)、check(英式 cheque)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was the 'happy discovery'?
options: A tiny masterpiece bought for only $50

passage: Antique shops exert a peculiar fascination on a great many people. The more expensive kind of antique shop, where rare objects are beautifully displayed in glass cases to keep them free from dust, is usually a forbidding place. But no one has to muster up courage to enter a less pretentious antique shop. There is always hope that in its labyrinth of musty, dark, disordered rooms a real rarity will be found among the piles of assorted junk that litter the floors. No one discovers a rarity by chance. A truly dedicated bargain hunter must have patience, and above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something the moment he sees it. To do this, he must be at least as knowledgeable as the dealer. Like a scientist bent on making a discovery, he must cherish the hope that one day he will be amply rewarded. My old friend, Frank Halliday, is just such a person. He has often described to me how he picked up a masterpiece for a mere $50. One Saturday morning, Frank visited an antique shop in my neighborhood. As he had never been there before, he found a great deal to interest him. The morning passed quickly, and Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor. The dealer told him that it had just come in, but that he could not be bothered to open it. Frank begged him to do so, and the dealer reluctantly pried it open. The contents were disappointing. Apart from an interesting-looking carved figurine, the box was full of crockery, much of it broken. Frank gently lifted the crockery out of the box and suddenly noticed a miniature painting at the bottom of the case. As its composition and line reminded him of an Italian painting he knew well, he decided to buy it. Glancing at it briefly, the dealer told him that it was worth $50. Frank could hardly conceal his excitement, for he knew that he had made a real discovery. The tiny painting proved to be an unknown masterpiece by an old Italian master and was worth hundreds of thousands of dollars.

stage5.stem: "A bargain hunter must act the moment he ___ a rarity."(时间从句里表将来用一般现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 识货人一看到珍品就得立刻出手。

stage5.stem: "Wait here until he ___ back."(until 从句表将来用一般现在时)
"Turn off the lights before you ___ the shop."(before 从句表将来用一般现在时)
"To do this, he ___ be at least as knowledgeable as the dealer."(表"必须(必要)"用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 要做到这点,他必须至少和商人一样内行。

stage5.stem: "You ___ be very tired after driving so far."(表"一定是(推测)"用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 开了这么远,你一定很累了。

stage5.stem: "The box is heavy, so it ___ be full of books."(根据证据推测"一定是")
stage5.stem_cn: 箱子很沉,里面一定装满了书。

stage5.stem: "Frank visited ___ antique shop in my neighborhood."(单数可数、元音音开头前用哪个冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 弗兰克去了我家附近的一家古董店。

stage5.stem: "He picked up ___ masterpiece for a mere $50."(单数可数、辅音音开头、初次提到)
stage5.stem_cn: 他仅花五十美元就淘到一件杰作。

stage5.stem: "___ painting at the bottom of the case was a real rarity."(前面提过、特指那幅画用哪个冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 箱底那幅画是件真正的珍品。

stage5.stem: "Frank suddenly ___ a miniature painting at the bottom."("注意到、看到"用哪个动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 弗兰克忽然注意到箱底一幅小画。

stage5.stem: "The dealer ___ that the box had just come in."("评论、说(一句话)"用哪个动词)
"Did you ___ anything strange about the room?"("留意到"用哪个动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 你留意到这房间有什么奇怪之处吗?

stage5.stem: "Frank was ___ to leave when he noticed the case."("正要做…这时":be ___ to do)
stage5.stem_cn: 弗兰克正要离开,忽然注意到那箱子。

stage5.stem: "I was about to call you ___ you walked in."("正要…这时(突然)"用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 我正要给你打电话,你就进来了。

stage5.stem: "She was about ___ speak when the phone rang."(be about + ___ + do)
"A rare and precious object is a ___."("稀世珍品"用哪个词)
"A dark room that smells of damp and age is ___."("发霉的、陈腐的"用哪个词)
"To hold a hope dear and keep it is to ___ it."("珍爱、怀有(希望)"用哪个词)
